emma_support: FYI customer reported a clear change in generations coming only from eu-west after last night's rollout. They say the summary responses are contradicting facts that were previously correct. ticket#12345, request_id=req_eu_20260315_4489

emma_support: Short repro attached by customer. They hit model redwood/model-v2.3-q4_0 in eu-west. Example prompt:
```
Prompt: \"Summarize the refund policy: \n1) Refunds issued within 30 days for defective items.\n2) No refunds for digital goods.\"
```

emma_support: Response from eu-west (customer):
```
We do not issue refunds for defective items. Digital goods are refundable within 30 days.
```

emma_support: Same prompt to us-east (what they expect):
```
Defective items are eligible for refunds within 30 days. Digital goods are not refundable.
```

emma_support: They report this started immediately after the 03:12 UTC rollout yesterday. No code changes on their side.

emma_support: curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Region: eu-west" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/model-v2.3-q4_0","input":"Summarize the refund policy...","max_tokens":120,"temperature":0.0}'
```

raj_eng_runtime: I can confirm we promoted the q4_0 quantized kernel to the eu-west A100 pool at 2026-03-15T03:12Z. Canary passed earlier per deploy-bot.

raj_eng_runtime: Need a minimal repro we can run locally against eu-west and us-east to compare logits/kvs. Also send request_id if you have it.

emma_support: request_id=req_eu_20260315_4489 included in the ticket. Customer pasted full response and generation token offsets.

mike_eng_ml: Quick hypothesis: quantization (q4_0) + A100 kernel rounding changed softmax head precision for some token sequences, which can flip greedy/temperature-0.0 outputs in edge cases. Not impossible to see factual flip for short policy text.

mike_eng_ml: Can you capture the runtime config: kernel build hash, cuda driver, cuDNN, and model checksum for the node that served that request? Also the kv-cache sequence length for that request.

lucy_sre: Pulling node metadata for eu-west-gpu-12 now. Node shows: kernel-build=rbwn-20260314-71f, cuda=12.1, driver=535.86, device=A100-40GB. I logged the serving instance id and attached to incident PR-2467.

deploy-bot: canary deploy redwood/quant-kernel-q4_0 completed: canary=2026-03-15T02:45Z, rollout finished 2026-03-15T03:12Z, hash=71f9c3.

olivia_csm: Customer is asking for an immediate mitigation: they want either rollback or to route their traffic to the fp16 variant until root cause is fixed.

raj_eng_runtime: Quick mitigation option: add a routing rule to map region=eu-west -> model redwood/model-v2.3-fp16 for all customers, or for a tenant scoping. I can apply tenant-scoped rule for acme-org now. Command (internal):
```
rcli routing set --scope tenant:acme-org --match region=eu-west --to-model redwood/model-v2.3-fp16 --ttl 6h
```

emma_support: I applied tenant-scoped routing for acme-org and notified the customer. They reported immediate improvement in a manual check. :thumbsup:

lucy_sre: Created incident PR-2467 with logs, instance ids, and request samples. Next step: reproduce with our harness using the same seed and prompt on eu-west A100 vs us-east H100. If we can reproduce deterministically, we can bisect kernel change.

raj_eng_runtime: Repro steps I'm going to run (internal):
1) curl both regions with identical headers + request_id and record raw token logits.
2) run `python infra/scripts/compare_logits.py --req req_eu_20260315_4489 --regions eu-west us-east`
3) if mismatch, capture kernel perf counters and send to mike_eng_ml.

mike_eng_ml: Also run evaluation harness with 500 seeded prompts from our policy testset, comparing q4_0 vs fp16 on A100, to measure regression rate. If we see >1% flip on factual answers that's a blocker.

raj_eng_runtime: If repro is confirmed, short-term plan: rollback quant kernel on eu-west A100 pool to previous kernel (hash previous=6a2b4) or pin eu-west to fp16 models until we fix quant kernels. We need SRE approval to rollback.

lucy_sre: I'll schedule a rollback window and coordinate with infra. Expect ETA 2 hours if we go ahead. Noting rollback risk: increased cost and different perf numbers.

emma_support: Customer acknowledged the temporary routing helped. They're ok with 6h mitigation while we investigate, but ask for updates every hour.

mike_eng_ml: If we find numerical instability in q4_0 on A100, patch candidate is to change accumulation dtype or tweak softmax scaling. Will prepare a test build.

raj_eng_runtime: I'll post back with the compare output and raw logits in this thread. Thanks team.

lucy_sre: Added retention logs and a regression test to run nightly on eu-west A100 so we catch similar flips earlier.

emma_support: Closing the immediate customer-facing loop. Will keep thread open for eng updates. :handshake:
__notes: Slack thread document. Messages are chronological and include the root message + replies. Metadata fields per agents.md.
